```{python}
def qb_epa_by_play(data: pd.DataFrame, team_col: str = "posteam"):
    required = {"game_id", "qb_epa", "play_id", team_col}
    missing = required - set(data.columns)
    if missing:
        raise KeyError(f"missing required columns: {sorted(missing)}")

    df = data.copy()

    # Build mask similar to your game version
    if "qb_dropback" in df.columns:
        dropback_mask = df["qb_dropback"].astype("float64").fillna(0.0).astype(bool)
    else:
        dropback_mask = df["qb_epa"].notna()

    mask = (
        dropback_mask
        & df[team_col].notna()
        & df["qb_epa"].notna()
    )

    for col in ["qb_spike", "qb_kneel", "two_point_attempt"]:
        if col in df.columns:
            mask &= ~df[col].astype("float64").fillna(0.0).astype(bool)

    if "season_type" in df.columns:
        mask &= (df["season_type"] == "REG")

    plays = df.loc[mask, ["game_id", team_col, "qb_epa"]].copy()
    plays = plays.rename(columns={team_col: "posteam"})
    # Per-play rows: total=qb_epa, count=1
    plays["total"] = plays["qb_epa"]
    plays["count"] = 1
    return plays[["game_id", "posteam", "total", "count"]]

```

```{python}
from typing import Optional, Callable

def feature_per_game(data: pd.DataFrame, value_col: str, team_col: str, where: Optional[Callable[[pd.DataFrame], pd.Series]] = None
):

    needed = {"game_id", team_col, "play_id", value_col}
    missing = needed - set(data.columns)
    if missing:
        raise KeyError(f"Missing required columns: {sorted(missing)}")

    df = data.copy()
    base_mask = df[value_col].notna() & df[team_col].notna()
    if where is not None:
        cond = where(df)
        if not isinstance(cond, pd.Series) or cond.shape[0] != df.shape[0]:
            raise ValueError("where(...) must return a boolean Series aligned with data")
        base_mask &= cond

    dff = df.loc[base_mask, ["game_id", team_col, value_col, "play_id"]].copy()

    out = (
        dff.groupby(["game_id", team_col], as_index=False)
           .agg(total=(value_col, "sum"),
                count=("play_id", "nunique"))
           .rename(columns={team_col: "posteam"})
           .sort_values(["game_id", "posteam"], ignore_index=True)
    )
    return out

```

```{python}
def qb_epa_by_game(data: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """
    Summarize QB EPA at the game level.
    Returns total EPA and number of dropbacks per team per game.
    """
    plays = qb_epa_by_play(data)
    game_level = (
        plays.groupby(["game_id", "posteam"], as_index=False)
             .agg(qb_total_epa=("total", "sum"),
                  qb_dropbacks=("count", "sum"))
    )
    return game_level

```

```{python}
def build_features(data: pd.DataFrame, week: int, function: Callable[[pd.DataFrame], pd.DataFrame], *, team_col: str = "posteam", total_col: str = "total", count_col: str = "count", rate_name: str = "prior_rate"):

    if "game_id" not in data.columns or "week" not in data.columns:

        raise KeyError("data frame must contain game_id and week columns")

    game_level = function(data) # function to get per_game data

    game_info = data[["game_id", "week"]].drop_duplicates()
    game_level = game_level.merge(game_info, on="game_id", how="left")
    game_level = game_level.loc[game_level['week'] < week].copy()

    agg = (
        game_level.groupby("posteam", as_index=False)
                  .agg(
                      **{f"prior_{total_col}": (total_col, "sum"),
                         f"prior_{count_col}": (count_col, "sum")}
                  )
    )

    agg["week"] = week
    agg[rate_name] = np.where(
        agg[f"prior_{count_col}"] > 0,
        agg[f"prior_{total_col}"] / agg[f"prior_{count_col}"],
        np.nan
    )

    return agg[["week", "posteam",
                f"prior_{total_col}", f"prior_{count_col}", rate_name]]

```

```{python}
def feature_sum_per_game(data: pd.DataFrame,value_col: str, team_col: str, where=None
):
    needed = {"game_id", team_col, value_col}
    missing = needed - set(data.columns)
    if missing:
        raise KeyError(f"Missing required columns: {sorted(missing)}")

    df = data.copy()
    mask = df[value_col].notna() & df[team_col].notna()
    if where is not None:
        cond = where(df)
        if not isinstance(cond, pd.Series) or cond.shape[0] != df.shape[0]:
            raise ValueError("where(...) must return a boolean Series aligned with data")
        mask &= cond

    dff = df.loc[mask, ["game_id", team_col, value_col]].copy()

    out = (
        dff.groupby(["game_id", team_col], as_index=False)
           .agg(total=(value_col, "sum"))
           .rename(columns={team_col: "posteam"})
           .sort_values(["game_id", "posteam"], ignore_index=True)
    )

    out["count"] = 1
    return out[["game_id", "posteam", "total", "count"]]

```

```{python}
def qb_epa_rate_per_game(data: pd.DataFrame):
    g = qb_epa_by_game(data)
    g = g.assign(
        total = np.where(g["qb_dropbacks"] > 0, g["qb_total_epa"] / g["qb_dropbacks"], np.nan),
        count = 1
    )
    return g[["game_id", "posteam", "total", "count"]]
```

```{python}
def turnover_margin_per_game(data: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    required = {"game_id", "posteam", "defteam", "fumble_lost", "interception"}
    missing = required - set(data.columns)
    if missing:
        raise KeyError(f"Missing columns: {sorted(missing)}")

    df = data.copy()

    
    df["turnover_lost"] = (
        df["fumble_lost"].fillna(0).astype(int)
        + df["interception"].fillna(0).astype(int)
    )

    
    lost = (
        df.groupby(["game_id", "posteam"], as_index=False)
          .agg(turnovers_lost=("turnover_lost", "sum"))
          .rename(columns={"posteam": "team"})
    )

    
    gained = (
        df.groupby(["game_id", "defteam"], as_index=False)
          .agg(turnovers_gained=("turnover_lost", "sum"))
          .rename(columns={"defteam": "team"})
    )

    result = pd.merge(lost, gained, on=["game_id", "team"], how="outer").fillna(0)
    result["turnover_margin"] = result["turnovers_gained"] - result["turnovers_lost"]

    result = result.rename(columns={"team": "posteam"})

    result["count"] = 1

    result = result.sort_values(["game_id", "posteam"], ignore_index=True)

    return result[["game_id", "posteam", "turnovers_lost", "turnovers_gained", "turnover_margin", "count"]]
```

```{python}
target = 10

def combine(data: pd.DataFrame, metric_col, new_col, week=target):
    out = data.copy()
    if "week" in out.columns:
        out = out.loc[out['week'] == week]
    out = out[['posteam', metric_col]].rename(columns={metric_col: new_col})

    if out.duplicated('posteam').any():
        raise ValueError("duplicate")
    return out

qb = combine(wk10_qb_gameavg,"prior_qb_epa_per_db_avg_game", "qb_epa_per_db_g")

off = combine(wk10_off,"prior_off_yards_per_game", "off_yds_g")

deff = combine(wk10_def,"prior_def_yards_per_game","yds_allowed_g")

fd   = combine(wk10_fdowns,"prior_first_downs_per_game", "first_downs_g")

fda  = combine(wk10_fdowns_allowed,"prior_first_downs_allowed_per_game","first_downs_allowed_g")

tda  = combine(wk_10_td_allowed, "prior_tds_allowed_per_game", "td_allowed_g")
```

```{python}
def game_winner_target(data: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:

    required = {"game_id", "home_team", "away_team", "total_home_score", "total_away_score"}
    missing = required - set(data.columns)
    if missing:
        raise KeyError(f"Missing required columns: {sorted(missing)}")

    df = data.copy()

    game_scores = (
        df[["game_id", "home_team", "away_team", "total_home_score", "total_away_score"]]
        .drop_duplicates(subset=["game_id"])
        .reset_index(drop=True)
    )

    game_scores["winner"] = np.where(
        game_scores["total_home_score"] > game_scores["total_away_score"],
        game_scores["home_team"],
        np.where(
            game_scores["total_home_score"] < game_scores["total_away_score"],
            game_scores["away_team"],
            np.nan
        )
    )

    game_scores["loser"] = np.where(
        game_scores["winner"] == game_scores["home_team"],
        game_scores["away_team"],
        game_scores["home_team"]
    )

    winners = game_scores[["game_id", "winner"]].rename(columns={"winner": "posteam"})
    winners["target"] = 1

    losers = game_scores[["game_id", "loser"]].rename(columns={"loser": "posteam"})
    losers["target"] = 0

    target_df = pd.concat([winners, losers], ignore_index=True).sort_values(["game_id", "posteam"])

    return target_df[["game_id", "posteam", "target"]]
```
